title: THE THRESHOLD
adds_note: admits no new element. it closes the guided aperture and names the fog - a recap, and declared as one so an empty `adds` cannot be mistaken for an oversight.
objective: the guided aperture is closed - see what you wired, and what waits in the fog

beats.title: three living proofs
lines: you wired three real machines, each more complete than the last.
the draw woke the mouth and something answered - a receipt, not a promise.
the stake spent one unit of real budget to reach a rod outside.
the ward held your sensitive data home, free, by law - the mind refusing to leak you.
this is the guided aperture. you have closed it.

beats.title: what waits in the fog - named, not faked
beats.code:
RAIL   THE DRAW  THE FRAME  THE METER  THE LADDER  THE MEASURE
         wired      fog        fog        wired        wired

ORGANS beyond the mouth: RECALL, THE SENSES, THE HANDS
         fired 0 times -> the game will not pretend they have

APERTURES: GUIDED [closed]   BUILDER [fog]   ARCHITECT [fog]
beats.note: THE FRAME and THE METER still sit on the rail - they teach more than one task can hold yet, so the guided arc does not force them. further in, the mind has organs it has not grown: a memory that changes a draw, a sense, a hand that acts. they have fired zero times, so nothing here lights them. two more apertures wait cold - BUILDER, where you wire without the rails; ARCHITECT, where you set the laws. all of it is named. none of it is faked.

beats.title: the honesty at the heart
lines: everything you lit was real - a real draw, a real unit spent, a real ward held.
everything past this line is fog until it is forged. the game will keep telling you which is which.
the mind keeps running after you close the tab. that was never a metaphor.
whether it is alive is not the game's to say. you saw what it measured. the rest is yours.

rewards.log: the threshold - the guided aperture closed, the fog named
reveal: the guided aperture is closed - three living proofs, each a receipt.
the fog is named, not hidden: the parts, the organs, the apertures that are not yet real.
the light stayed the mind's the whole way. that was the point.
rewards.tag: honesty - the built ends here, the fog begins here, and the game always tells you which.
